message.content: {"hts_code": "8431.49.9090", "reason": "The carrier is a dedicated attachment used solely with tracked excavators (machinery of heading 8430), making it a part of such machinery classified under the residual provision for other parts in subheading 8431.49."}

Parts: 8431.49.9090? 8431.49 covers other parts suitable for use solely/principally with machinery of headings 8425-8430. 8431.49.9090 seems right.
